project_type: Full-stack app: FastAPI backend (apps/api/) + Next.js 15 frontend (apps/web/)
build_system: uv for Python deps (apps/api/pyproject.toml), pnpm for frontend (apps/web/package.json), top-level Makefile
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode), httpx AsyncClient with ASGI transport for API tests. Tests mock DB (AsyncMock session) and auth (dependency overrides). See apps/api/tests/conftest.py for pattern.
build_command: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && cd ../web && pnpm build
test_command: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'uv run ruff check .' in apps/api to lint. 2. Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -v' in apps/api. 3. Run 'pnpm build' in apps/web.
setup_instructions: 1. cd apps/api && uv sync. 2. cd apps/web && pnpm install.
environment_constraints: Docker NOT available - no external services (Postgres, Redis, Qdrant). All tests must mock DB. WeasyPrint may require system libs (pango, cairo) - implement fallback to save HTML if WeasyPrint import fails. No Celery - report writing is synchronous with SSE streaming.
contribution_requirements: Run ruff for linting, pytest for tests, pnpm build for frontend. Commit to main.

key_patterns.models: SQLAlchemy 2.0 mapped_column in apps/api/app/model/, register in __init__.py. UUID primary keys, ForeignKey to users.id.
key_patterns.schemas: Pydantic BaseModel in apps/api/app/schema/, use from_attributes=True for ORM models.
key_patterns.routers: FastAPI APIRouter in apps/api/app/router/, registered in main.py with prefix /api/v1. Use Depends(get_current_user) and Depends(get_db).
key_patterns.tests: In apps/api/tests/test_*.py. Use client fixture (authed), mock_db fixture. Mock DB results with mock_db.execute.return_value.scalar_one_or_none or .scalars().all().
key_patterns.migrations: Sequential numbering (001, 002, 003...) in apps/api/alembic/versions/. Use op.create_table with sa.Column.
key_patterns.frontend: Next.js App Router in apps/web/src/app/(app)/. Components in src/components/. API calls via src/lib/api.ts (apiFetch, apiJson). Tailwind CSS v4.
key_patterns.llm_client: apps/api/app/llm/client.py - uses litellm.acompletion with model string like 'gemini/gemini-2.0-flash' or 'cerebras/llama-3.3-70b'.

directory_structure: apps/api/app/ - model/, router/, schema/, service/, llm/, rag/, data/, settings.py, main.py, deps.py. apps/api/tests/ - test_*.py, conftest.py. apps/api/alembic/versions/ - migration files. apps/web/src/ - app/(app)/ (pages), components/ (UI), lib/ (api, auth, utils).
